grounding.conclusion: VRSBench grounds 26 discrete man-made object classes (vehicle, ship, airplane, tennis-court, ...); the system grounds areal spectral land-cover classes (water, vegetation, built_up, ...). Vocabulary overlap is 0, so referring-object IoU is N/A by construction -- the system performs a different grounding task. The IoU implementation is validated (self-check = 1/7 = 0.1429) and is exercised on real masks by the fusion/change ablations.
